title: salix grandifolia var. lanata
intro:
Salix grandifolia var. lanata, commonly known as the Woolly Willow, is a variety of willow tree that is characterized by its distinctive woolly leaves and stems. The leaves and bark of this plant have been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Salix grandifolia var. lanata include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylic acid, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing fever, pain, and inflammation.
